record: 27 September 2026 build record 2 — integrated private foundations

rows.progress: The provider/model/tier is pinned for the entire controlled run, not readmitted each round. Returned identity mismatch retains paid usage but cannot execute a tool. Retry cannot switch its provider or model.
rows.gaps: Live provider interoperability and independent model calibration remain open. Only the currently authorised provider may receive matter text.

rows.progress: Exact retry now binds the original requested dispute scope, checked substantive source, resource grant and provider identity. The loop's own atomic writes and journal-only version advances remain valid; external corrections require new work.
rows.gaps: Recorded/synthetic only. Production research orchestration, remaining capability owners, live quality and normal-client cutover are not complete.

rows.progress: Actual saved source reads and independent verdicts now reach final assessment through Application composition. All eighteen output and six boundary slots are present, with missing consistency, currency, derivation or duty owners explicitly unassessed. Private repairs use only actual repairable claim failures; immutable owner failures stop and disclosure reservations survive later repairs. Authoring and judge calls share step limits; context assembly and final checks count toward elapsed time.
rows.gaps: Not all actual owner subjects or final publication are implemented. Private candidates never create a client TurnReceipt, and client readiness is always false. Complete absolute/relative quality acceptance remains open.

rows.progress: Application final assessment reads recorded parties, current screens and the actual commission/actor authority. Before/after tool admission enforces current session, file version and declared operation authority; it does not pretend every professional screen was separately performed around every tool.
rows.gaps: Independent duty and complete professional screening around controlled publication remain open. Missing or stale screens never become clear by model assertion.

rows.progress: Separate saved review judgments bind exact final paragraphs, real captured source windows and recorded premises. Actual child dispatches count against the same remaining step allowance, and completed/cancelled/discarded work keeps its measured spend.
rows.gaps: The distinct live judge model has not been approved or run. Qualified labels, calibration, semantic acceptance and professional review are still open.

rows.progress: The actual Application registry includes read/source/practice tools, atomic prepared writes and limitation/interest wrappers. Limitation computes only through the existing arithmetic owner from reviewed current fact and exact saved primary-source bindings. Without that resolver it is NOT_ASSESSED; interest is explicitly unavailable without reviewed rate and allocation rules.
rows.gaps: The full planned tool catalogue is not complete. Reviewed calculation selection, fee/interest/calendar rules, admitted-document indexing and legal-position/advice writes remain open; no law or formula was invented.

rows.progress: Research-specific recovery and compaction now preserve the exact task, scoped checked file, legal source windows, tools, principles and provider/model pins. Generic matter compaction refuses a research session rather than silently discarding its task. The actual controlled runner dispatches after validated recovery and compaction.
rows.gaps: Automatic capacity-triggered compaction and production multi-task orchestration remain unimplemented. Semantic research quality and live cache performance remain unmeasured.

rows.progress: Collapsed response progress attaches only to an authenticated genuine released-turn receipt and matching original instruction. Historic dispute labels survive board renames; shared stages explicitly do not claim separate assessments of every dispute. Unreleased work stays in History only. Two served Chromium presentation journeys exercised keyboard access, reopen, deduplication and logout refusal.
rows.gaps: Separately assessed per-dispute working display and question/answer streaming are not complete. Served controlled Chromium checks are not the signed-in owner's manual Chrome session or live-model evaluation.
